We need to combine subnetworks into full network topology. We have two subnet topologies with resistor IDs overlapping (both have R1 etc). Need unique IDs across whole network. Also need to ensure connections between subnets: likely they share nodes A, X1, B etc. Subnet1: nodes A - N1 - N2 - X1. Subnet2: nodes B - N_b1 - (N_b2,N_b3,X1). So overall network includes both. Need to combine resistor lists, rename to avoid conflict. Could keep original IDs but they conflict; we can rename subnet2 resistors with suffix maybe R4 etc. Already subnet2 has R1,R2,R3,R4. Subnet1 has R1,R2,R3. To avoid conflict, rename subnet2's resistors to R4,R5,R6,R7 (since total 7 resistors). Subnet1's resistors become R1,R2,R3. So final resistors: R1:2.727, R2:5.454, R3:8.182, R4:45.0, R5:10.0, R6:25.0, R7:5.0.

Connections: need to adjust IDs accordingly. Subnet1 connections unchanged: ["A","N1","R1"], ["N1","N2","R2"], ["N2","X1","R3"].

Subnet2 connections: rename R1->R4, R2->R5, R3->R6, R4->R7. So connections: ["B","N_b1","R4"], ["N_b1","N_b2","R5"], ["N_b1","N_b3","R6"], ["N_b1","X1","R7"].

Now we should validate against measurements using simulate_circuit_resistance? Could test a few measurement pairs to ensure consistency. Let's simulate A-B resistance should be 66.364. Use tool.
